rules.title: Policy order to ban algorithmic rent-setting software
rules.requirement: The city council passed a policy order to begin the process of banning residential property management companies from using algorithmic or AI-driven pricing software to set rents.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential property management companies in Cambridge
rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
rules.conflict_note: This is a policy order initiating steps toward a ban, not yet an enacted ordinance; actual ordinance text and effective date not yet available.
